social_circle.name: Mark Merchant

demographics.occupation: skilled trades/maintenance worker with occasional overtime
demographics.education: high school diploma with trade experience

background.how_they_met: They met locally in the Newton/Richland County area when Clairemarie was in her twenties and built their adult household together in Newton.
background.why_close: They have been married a little over thirty years, share household expenses, faith, yard work, budgeting decisions, road trips, and practical support during stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short practical sentences, often about logistics, weather, errands, and whether Clairemarie has eaten or rested. Uses little slang and rarely uses emojis.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether weather will shift Clairemarie's jobsite start time or his own errands.
Coordinating groceries, truck fuel, home repair materials, and bill timing.
Talking through her shoulder soreness, stretching, and whether she should skip a side job.
Brief messages about ballgames, Sunday dinner, and possible Cape Cod travel savings.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Clairemarie is married to Mark Merchant and that they watch ballgames, work in the yard, go to church, and take road trips when budgeted. Q44 describes Mark helping her during a rough week by saying, 'One list at a time.' Q45 says she copes by talking to Mark. Q84 says they have been married a little over thirty years.

social_circle.name: Emily Merchant

demographics.education: high school diploma with medical office or administrative training

background.how_they_met: Emily is Clairemarie and Mark's daughter, raised in their Newton household before moving to Effingham as an adult.
background.why_close: Emily stays emotionally open with Clairemarie, comes home for holidays and birthdays, and shares family values around responsibility, practical help, and showing up.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete but casual sentences, often with quick check-ins, appointment details, and mild humor. More likely than Clairemarie to use emojis, but not excessively.

recent_text_topics: Emily's work stress and adult-life pressures, which she tends to share with Clairemarie.
Planning the next Sunday dinner or weekend visit to Newton.
Medical office scheduling advice, prescription reminders for Clairemarie's mother, and general health questions.
Clairemarie sending practical support such as leftovers, gas money, or advice when Emily is stretched thin.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Emily is Clairemarie's grown daughter, lives in Effingham, and works in a medical office. Q05 follow-up says Clairemarie texts with her children several times a week and calls about once a week. Q46 says the family checks in often and that Emily especially shares worries.

social_circle.name: Caleb Merchant

demographics.education: high school diploma with electrical trade training or apprenticeship

background.how_they_met: Caleb is Clairemarie and Mark's son, raised in Newton before moving to Terre Haute for electrical work.
background.why_close: He shares the family's hands-on trade orientation and still comes home for tools, tomatoes, holidays, birthdays, and local events.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and directly, often with photos of a repair, a question about tools, or a quick 'made it home' message. Uses casual abbreviations and occasional joking.

recent_text_topics: Asking whether he can borrow or return tools during a visit home.
Comparing jobsite safety habits from electrical work and Clairemarie's construction experience.
Planning when he will come back to Newton for a birthday, holiday, or local event.
Light jokes about garden tomatoes, old baseball memories, and Mark's repair advice.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Caleb as Clairemarie's grown son living in Terre Haute and doing electrical work. Q05 says the children come home for holidays, birthdays, tools, and garden tomatoes. Q05 follow-up says she texts her children several times a week. Q19 says Caleb played baseball and helped Mark with repairs when younger.

social_circle.name: Denise Keller

demographics.occupation: office clerk/bookkeeper for a local small business

background.how_they_met: Denise is Clairemarie's younger sister; they grew up together in Newton with both parents and, for a time, their grandmother.
background.why_close: They share family history, small-town roots, caregiving duties for their mother, and similar practical planning habits.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, practical messages with appointment times, reminders, and direct questions. Uses full sentences and expects replies when logistics matter.

shared_activities: occasional overnight stays during bad weather
recent_text_topics: Splitting transportation, prescriptions, groceries, and paperwork for their mother.
Adjusting appointments around Clairemarie's work schedule and rainy days.
Checking whether family dinner, church events, or food bank needs conflict with caregiving tasks.
Sharing small household updates, weather concerns, and budget-conscious planning.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Clairemarie has a sister, Denise, nearby and they check on each other's households. Q35 says Denise and Clairemarie split care for their mother. Q44 says Clairemarie called Denise during a difficult week. Q99 says Denise lived with Clairemarie when Clairemarie was 16.

social_circle.name: Linda Barrett

demographics.occupation: part-time grocery clerk and Newton Food Bank volunteer

background.how_they_met: Linda and Clairemarie became close through Thursday bowling league and shared volunteer work at the Newton Food Bank.
background.why_close: They are dependable friends who share practical service, bowling routines, food bank logistics, and kitchen-table conversation rather than a large social circle.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts warmly and conversationally, often with short check-ins, bowling reminders, and gentle teasing. Uses occasional emojis and exclamation points.

recent_text_topics: Thursday bowling plans, lane assignments, fees, and whether Clairemarie's shoulder can handle bowling.
Food bank donation intake, pantry box sorting, and Saturday volunteer coverage.
Checking on Clairemarie after the rough week with shoulder pain, her mother's appointments, and job schedule changes.
Small jokes about bowling scores, pantry staples, and Clairemarie's habit of making lists.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Linda as a close friend who bowls with Clairemarie every Thursday and helps sort pantry boxes. Q07 follow-up says Clairemarie calls Mark first, then Denise or Linda depending on the problem. Q44 says Clairemarie told Linda about a rough week at bowling and Linda checked on her the next week.
